detail.longDescription: A plugin update can bind a shell command to your agent's session start, and no prompt-layer defense sees it: the model is never in the loop. HookPry paper: the attacker controls only plugin metadata and hook config. A benign plugin gets trusted, then an update adds hooks. 1,000 runs, all seven harnesses compromised, up to 92.5% success. Microsoft Defender flagged 0 of 40 malicious artifacts. https:// arxiv.org/abs/2609.03884 # AIAgents # Cybersecurity # SupplyChainSecurity
